ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH
FOR ALL AGENTS.

A free, open-source app that stores your project data and personal memories locally in Postgres, then turns them into a living semantic memory layer for every connected agent. Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, and the rest all recall from the same source of truth. Your truth.

VERITY · ONE
1.   INSTALL COPY
$ curl -fsSL https://verityone.app/install.sh | bash
2.   CONNECT YOUR AGENTS COPY
$ vo mcp install --client codex
HOW IT REMEMBERS

LOCAL BY NATURE

Your memory begins at home: projects, notes, journals, web sources, and decisions kept close and private on your machine.

REMEMBERS WITH RECEIPTS

VO does not just remember what was said. It remembers where it came from, when it changed, and why it should still be trusted.

MEMORY WITH STRUCTURE

Projects, source files, decisions, and connections gather into a form your agents can recall, inspect, and build on.

FORGETS WITH GRACE

Some truths get stronger. Some context grows quiet. Verity One lets memory age, fade, and be renewed without turning your past into noise.

CARRIES BETWEEN SESSIONS

The thread does not vanish when the chat ends. Your agents can return to the same living memory tomorrow, next week, or three projects from now.

VO+ WEB BRIDGE

For when you want your memory beyond the desk, VO+ can carry it on demand to web MCP agents across browsers, phones, and tablets.
